    AI Overview
    A form webhook notification automatically sends an HTTP POST request to a designated URL the moment a user submits your form. Instead of manually checking for data, the form pushes the response payload directly to your server, database, or automation tool (like Zapier) in real-time. 
    Setting up this automated data transmission requires two main steps: 
    1. Configure the Destination: Set up a webhook URL endpoint on your backend server or use an automation integration service to catch and process the incoming JSON payload.
    2. Add the URL to Your Form: Go to your form builder's settings or integrations panel (e.g., Typeform, Formstack, or Netlify) and paste your destination URL. 
    Could you tell me which form builder or platform you are using (e.g., Google Forms, Typeform, Webflow, WordPress) so I can give you the exact steps and setup codes?
